1	"""In-process resource registry and registration validation."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import re
6	import uuid
7	from dataclasses import dataclass
8	
9	#: The four resource categories exposed by the service.
10	CATEGORIES: tuple[str, ...] = ("code", "model", "dataset", "artifact")
11	_CATEGORY_VALUES = frozenset(CATEGORIES)
12	
13	_DIGEST_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}")
14	_ALLOWED_FIELDS = frozenset({"name", "category", "digest", "source"})
15	_REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("name", "category", "digest")
16	
17	
18	class ResourceValidationError(ValueError):
19	    """A registration payload failed field-level validation."""
20	
21	    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
22	        super().__init__(message)
23	        self.message = message
24	
25	
26	class DependencyError(ValueError):
27	    """A dependency relation could not be established.
28	
29	    ``code`` is the stable, client-facing error code.
30	    """
31	
32	    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str) -> None:
33	        super().__init__(message)
34	        self.code = code
35	        self.message = message
36	
37	
38	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
39	class Resource:
40	    """A single registered resource record."""
41	
42	    id: str
43	    name: str
44	    category: str
45	    digest: str
46	    source: str | None
47	
48	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
49	        return {
50	            "id": self.id,
51	            "name": self.name,
52	            "category": self.category,
53	            "digest": self.digest,
54	            "source": self.source,
55	        }
56	
57	
58	def _require_non_empty_string(value: object, label: str) -> str:
59	    if not isinstance(value, str):
60	        raise ResourceValidationError(f"{label} must be a string.")
61	    if not value.strip():
62	        raise ResourceValidationError(f"{label} must not be empty.")
63	    return value
64	
65	
66	def build_resource_fields(
67	    payload: object,
68	) -> tuple[str, str, str, str | None]:
69	    """Validate a decoded JSON payload and return normalized field values."""
70	
71	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
72	        raise ResourceValidationError("Request body must be a JSON object.")
73	
74	    unknown_fields = set(payload) - _ALLOWED_FIELDS
75	    if unknown_fields:
76	        raise ResourceValidationError(
77	            f"Unknown field: {sorted(unknown_fields)[0]!r}."
78	        )
79	
80	    for field in _REQUIRED_FIELDS:
81	        if field not in payload:
82	            raise ResourceValidationError(
83	                f"Missing required field: {field!r}."
84	            )
85	
86	    name = _require_non_empty_string(payload["name"], "Name")
87	
88	    category_raw = payload["category"]
89	    if not isinstance(category_raw, str):
90	        raise ResourceValidationError("Category must be a string.")
91	    category = category_raw.lower()
92	    if category not in _CATEGORY_VALUES:
93	        allowed = ", ".join(CATEGORIES)
94	        raise ResourceValidationError(
95	            f"Category must be one of: {allowed} (case-insensitive)."
96	        )
97	
98	    digest_raw = payload["digest"]
99	    if not isinstance(digest_raw, str) or _DIGEST_PATTERN.fullmatch(
100	        digest_raw
101	    ) is None:
102	        raise ResourceValidationError(
103	            "Digest must be a 64-character hexadecimal string."
104	        )
105	    # Hexadecimal digests are case-insensitive; store them canonically.
106	    digest = digest_raw.lower()
107	
108	    source: str | None = None
109	    if "source" in payload:
110	        source = _require_non_empty_string(payload["source"], "Source")
111	
112	    return name, category, digest, source
113	
114	
115	class ResourceStore:
116	    """Process-local, insertion-ordered resource storage."""
117	
118	    def __init__(self) -> None:
119	        self._resources: list[Resource] = []
120	        self._by_id: dict[str, Resource] = {}
121	        self._key_to_id: dict[tuple[str, str, str], str] = {}
122	        # resource id -> ids it directly depends on, and the reverse view.
123	        self._dependencies: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
124	        self._dependents: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
125	
126	    def reset(self) -> None:
127	        self._resources.clear()
128	        self._resources = []
129	        self._by_id = {}
130	        self._key_to_id = {}
131	        self._dependencies = {}
132	        self._dependents = {}
133	
134	    def list_all(self) -> list[Resource]:
135	        return list(self._resources)
136	
137	    def query(
138	        self,
139	        *,
140	        category: str | None = None,
141	        name: str | None = None,
142	        digest: str | None = None,
143	    ) -> list[Resource]:
144	        """Return matching resources in creation order.
145	
146	        ``category`` is compared case-insensitively, ``name`` is an exact
147	        string match and ``digest`` is compared against the stored lowercase
148	        form. Multiple conditions are AND-ed together.
149	        """
150	
151	        if category is None and name is None and digest is None:
152	            return list(self._resources)
153	
154	        matches: list[Resource] = []
155	        for resource in self._resources:
156	            if category is not None and resource.category != category.lower():
157	                continue
158	            if name is not None and resource.name != name:
159	                continue
160	            if digest is not None and resource.digest != digest:
161	                continue
162	            matches.append(resource)
163	        return matches
164	
165	    def get(self, resource_id: str) -> Resource | None:
166	        return self._by_id.get(resource_id)
167	
168	    def add(
169	        self, payload: object
170	    ) -> tuple[Resource | None, Resource | None]:
171	        """Validate and store a resource.
172	
173	        Returns ``(created, None)`` on success or ``(None, existing)`` when
174	        the same category, name and digest are already registered.
175	        """
176	
177	        name, category, digest, source = build_resource_fields(payload)
178	        key = (category, name, digest)
179	        existing_id = self._key_to_id.get(key)
180	        if existing_id is not None:
181	            return None, self._by_id[existing_id]
182	
183	        resource = Resource(
184	            id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
185	            name=name,
186	            category=category,
187	            digest=digest,
188	            source=source,
189	        )
190	        self._resources.append(resource)
191	        self._by_id[resource.id] = resource
192	        self._key_to_id[key] = resource.id
193	        self._dependencies[resource.id] = set()
194	        self._dependents[resource.id] = set()
195	        return resource, None
196	
197	    def add_remote(
198	        self,
199	        *,
200	        name: str,
201	        category: str,
202	        digest: str,
203	        source: str | None,
204	        resource_id: str | None = None,
205	    ) -> Resource:
206	        """Store a resource resolved from a remote repository.
207	
208	        The caller has already validated the fields and matched the digest
209	        against the registry, so the record is constructed directly; the
210	        same uniqueness key is enforced defensively. When ``resource_id``
211	        is given it is reused (the caller already minted it during
212	        planning); otherwise a fresh id is generated.
213	        """
214	
215	        key = (category, name, digest)
216	        existing_id = self._key_to_id.get(key)
217	        if existing_id is not None:
218	            return self._by_id[existing_id]
219	
220	        resource = Resource(
221	            id=resource_id if resource_id is not None else uuid.uuid4().hex,
222	            name=name,
223	            category=category,
224	            digest=digest,
225	            source=source,
226	        )
227	        self._resources.append(resource)
228	        self._by_id[resource.id] = resource
229	        self._key_to_id[key] = resource.id
230	        self._dependencies[resource.id] = set()
231	        self._dependents[resource.id] = set()
232	        return resource
233	
234	    def discard(self, resource_id: str) -> None:
235	        """Remove a resource that has no edges yet.
236	
237	        Used to roll back a resource created during an aborted operation.
238	        Only safe for resources with no dependencies or dependents.
239	        """
240	
241	        resource = self._by_id.pop(resource_id, None)
242	        if resource is None:
243	            return
244	        self._resources = [r for r in self._resources if r.id != resource_id]
245	        self._key_to_id.pop(
246	            (resource.category, resource.name, resource.digest), None
247	        )
248	        self._dependencies.pop(resource_id, None)
249	        self._dependents.pop(resource_id, None)
250	
251	    # --- Dependencies ------------------------------------------------------
252	
253	    def _reachable(self, start: str, graph: dict[str, set[str]]) -> set[str]:
254	        """Transitive closure of ``start`` through ``graph`` (start excluded)."""
255	
256	        seen: set[str] = set()
257	        stack = list(graph.get(start, ()))
258	        while stack:
259	            node = stack.pop()
260	            if node in seen:
261	                continue
262	            seen.add(node)
263	            stack.extend(graph.get(node, ()))
264	        return seen
265	
266	    def _registration_order(self, ids: set[str]) -> list[str]:
267	        return [r.id for r in self._resources if r.id in ids]
268	
269	    def check_dependency(self, resource_id: str, dependency_id: str) -> None:
270	        """Validate an edge without mutating the graph.
271	
272	        Raises :class:`DependencyError` with code ``duplicate_dependency``
273	        when the same-direction relation already exists, or
274	        ``dependency_cycle`` for a self loop or a relation that would
275	        introduce a cycle.
276	        """
277	
278	        if resource_id == dependency_id:
279	            raise DependencyError(
280	                "dependency_cycle", "A resource must not depend on itself."
281	            )
282	
283	        existing = self._dependencies.get(resource_id, ())
284	        if dependency_id in existing:
285	            raise DependencyError(
286	                "duplicate_dependency",
287	                "This dependency relation already exists.",
288	            )
289	
290	        # Adding resource_id -> dependency_id creates a cycle whenever
291	        # dependency_id can already reach resource_id.
292	        if resource_id in self._reachable(dependency_id, self._dependencies):
293	            raise DependencyError(
294	                "dependency_cycle",
295	                "This dependency would introduce a cycle.",
296	            )
297	
298	    def add_dependency(self, resource_id: str, dependency_id: str) -> None:
299	        """Record that ``resource_id`` depends on ``dependency_id``.
300	
301	        Both resources must already be registered. Raises
302	        :class:`DependencyError` with code ``duplicate_dependency`` when the
303	        same-direction relation already exists, or ``dependency_cycle`` for a
304	        self loop or a relation that would introduce a cycle; in either case
305	        the graph is left unchanged.
306	        """
307	
308	        self.check_dependency(resource_id, dependency_id)
309	        self._dependencies[resource_id].add(dependency_id)
310	        self._dependents[dependency_id].add(resource_id)
311	
312	    def list_dependencies(self, resource_id: str) -> list[str]:
313	        """Return every reachable dependency id in registration order."""
314	
315	        return self._registration_order(
316	            self._reachable(resource_id, self._dependencies)
317	        )
318	
319	    def list_impact(self, resource_id: str) -> list[str]:
320	        """Return ids that directly or transitively depend on ``resource_id``.
321	
322	        The start resource itself is excluded; results are in registration
323	        order.
324	        """
325	
326	        return self._registration_order(
327	            self._reachable(resource_id, self._dependents)
328	        )

204	    if not dot or not token_b64 or not sig_b64:
205	        raise ListQueryError("Cursor is malformed.")
206	    try:
207	        token = _b64decode(token_b64)
208	        sig = _b64decode(sig_b64)
209	    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
210	        raise ListQueryError("Cursor is malformed.") from None
211	
212	    if not token.isdigit() or token.startswith(b"0") or int(token) <= 0:
213	        raise ListQueryError("Cursor is malformed.")
214	    offset = int(token)
215	
216	    expected = _cursor_signature(category, name, digest, limit, offset)
217	    if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected):
218	        raise ListQueryError("Cursor is not valid for this request.")
219	    return offset

222	def parse_list_query(query_string: str) -> ListQuery:
223	    """Parse and validate the query string for ``GET /resources``."""
224	
225	    pairs = parse_qsl(query_string, keep_blank_values=True, strict_parsing=False)
226	    seen: set[str] = set()
227	    raw_values: dict[str, str] = {}
228	    for key, value in pairs:
229	        if key not in _LIST_PARAMS:
230	            raise ListQueryError(f"Unknown query parameter: {key!r}.")
231	        if key in seen:
232	            raise ListQueryError(f"Query parameter {key!r} must not be repeated.")
233	        seen.add(key)
234	        raw_values[key] = value
235	
236	    category: str | None = None
237	    if "category" in raw_values:
238	        value = raw_values["category"]
239	        if value == "":
240	            raise ListQueryError("Category must not be empty.")
241	        if value.lower() not in _CATEGORY_VALUES:
242	            allowed = ", ".join(CATEGORIES)
243	            raise ListQueryError(
244	                f"Category must be one of: {allowed} (case-insensitive)."
245	            )
246	        category = value.lower()
247	
248	    name: str | None = None
249	    if "name" in raw_values:
250	        value = raw_values["name"]
251	        # Exact, case-sensitive comparison; no trimming or folding.
252	        if value == "":
253	            raise ListQueryError("Name must not be empty.")
254	        name = value
255	
256	    digest: str | None = None
257	    if "digest" in raw_values:
258	        value = raw_values["digest"]
259	        if _DIGEST_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
260	            raise ListQueryError(
261	                "Digest must be a 64-character hexadecimal string."
262	            )
263	        digest = value.lower()
264	
265	    limit = DEFAULT_LIMIT
266	    if "limit" in raw_values:
267	        value = raw_values["limit"]
268	        if _POSITIVE_INT_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
269	            raise ListQueryError(
270	                f"Limit must be a positive integer no greater than {MAX_LIMIT}."
271	            )
272	        limit = int(value)
273	        if limit > MAX_LIMIT:
274	            raise ListQueryError(
275	                f"Limit must be a positive integer no greater than {MAX_LIMIT}."
276	            )
277	
278	    offset = 0
279	    if "cursor" in raw_values:
280	        value = raw_values["cursor"]
281	        if value == "":
282	            raise ListQueryError("Cursor is malformed.")
283	        offset = _decode_cursor(
284	            value, category or "", name or "", digest or "", limit
285	        )
286	
287	    paged = bool(seen)
288	    return ListQuery(
289	        category=category,
290	        name=name,
291	        digest=digest,
292	        limit=limit,
293	        offset=offset,
294	        paged=paged,
295	    )

299	    environ: dict[str, Any], start_response: StartResponse
300	) -> Iterable[bytes]:
301	    try:
302	        query = parse_list_query(str(environ.get("QUERY_STRING", "")))
303	    except ListQueryError as exc:

315	            "200 OK",

322	    )

338	        {"resources": [r.to_dict() for r in page], "next_cursor": next_cursor},
339	        trailing_newline=True,

347	    *,
348	    extra_headers: list[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,
349	    trailing_newline: bool = False,

705	def _read_declared_body(environ: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[bytes | None, str | None]:
706	    """Read exactly the declared request body for content verification.
707	
708	    Returns ``(body, None)`` on success or ``(None, message)`` when the
709	    ``Content-Length`` header is missing or malformed, the stream cannot be
710	    read, or fewer bytes than declared are available. An explicitly declared
711	    length of zero is a valid empty body, not a missing one.
712	    """
713	
714	    raw_length = environ.get("CONTENT_LENGTH")
715	    if not isinstance(raw_length, str):
716	        return None, "Content-Length header is required."
717	    if _NON_NEGATIVE_INT_PATTERN.fullmatch(raw_length) is None:
718	        return None, "Content-Length header must be a non-negative integer."
719	    length = int(raw_length)
720	
721	    try:
722	        body = environ["wsgi.input"].read(length)
723	    except Exception:
724	        return None, "Request body could not be read."
725	    if not isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray)) or len(body) != length:
726	        return None, "Request body is incomplete."
727	    return bytes(body), None

1944	def _admission_body_error(environ: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
1945	    """Reject an admission request that declares or carries a body."""
1946	
1947	    raw_length = environ.get("CONTENT_LENGTH")
1948	    if raw_length is None:
1949	        return None
1950	    if (
1951	        not isinstance(raw_length, str)
1952	        or _NON_NEGATIVE_INT_PATTERN.fullmatch(raw_length) is None
1953	        or int(raw_length) > 0
1954	    ):
1955	        return "This endpoint does not accept a request body."
1956	    return None

1959	def _bodyless_request_error(environ: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
1960	    """Reject a bodyless endpoint (cache DELETE) that declares a body.
1961	
1962	    Unlike admission, this also treats an empty-string ``Content-Length``
1963	    as no body: a real WSGI server seeds ``CONTENT_LENGTH`` with ``''``
1964	    for requests that omit the header entirely (e.g. curl's bodyless
1965	    DELETE), so only a declared positive or malformed length is rejected.
1966	    An explicit ``Content-Length: 0`` is an empty body and is accepted.
1967	    """
1968	
1969	    raw_length = environ.get("CONTENT_LENGTH")
1970	    if raw_length is None or raw_length == "":
1971	        return None
1972	    if (
1973	        not isinstance(raw_length, str)
1974	        or _NON_NEGATIVE_INT_PATTERN.fullmatch(raw_length) is None
1975	        or int(raw_length) > 0
1976	    ):
1977	        return "This endpoint does not accept a request body."
1978	    return None

1	"""In-process build provenance records for registered resources.
2	
3	Each resource keeps at most one provenance record describing a single
4	build: the builder, a build number, a source summary digest and a list of
5	materials. Digests are normalized to lowercase and materials keep their
6	submission order. Nothing here is persisted: stopping or restarting the
7	service clears every record, no signatures are verified, and promotion
8	rules are unaffected.
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import re
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	
16	#: A digest is exactly 64 hexadecimal characters; mixed case is accepted
17	#: but the digest is always stored and rendered in lowercase.
18	_DIGEST_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}")
19	
20	#: Text fields are non-empty and bounded by 256 Unicode code points.
21	MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 256
22	
23	#: Fields accepted by the registration request; anything else is rejected.
24	_ALLOWED_FIELDS = frozenset(
25	    {"builder", "build_number", "source_digest", "materials"}
26	)
27	_REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("builder", "build_number", "source_digest", "materials")
28	_MATERIAL_FIELDS = frozenset({"name", "digest"})
29	
30	
31	class ProvenanceValidationError(ValueError):
32	    """A provenance payload failed field-level validation."""
33	
34	    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
35	        super().__init__(message)
36	        self.message = message
37	
38	
39	class ProvenanceError(ValueError):
40	    """A provenance operation could not proceed.
41	
42	    ``code`` is the stable, client-facing error code.
43	    """
44	
45	    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str) -> None:
46	        super().__init__(message)
47	        self.code = code
48	        self.message = message
49	
50	
51	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
52	class Material:
53	    """A single build material identified by name and digest."""
54	
55	    name: str
56	    digest: str
57	
58	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
59	        return {"name": self.name, "digest": self.digest}
60	
61	
62	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
63	class ProvenanceRecord:
64	    """The single build provenance record stored for a resource."""
65	
66	    builder: str
67	    build_number: str
68	    source_digest: str
69	    materials: tuple[Material, ...]
70	
71	    def to_dict(self, resource_id: str) -> dict[str, object]:
72	        return {
73	            "id": resource_id,
74	            "builder": self.builder,
75	            "build_number": self.build_number,
76	            "source_digest": self.source_digest,
77	            "materials": [material.to_dict() for material in self.materials],
78	        }
79	
80	
81	def _required_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:
82	    """Validate a required non-empty string of at most 256 code points."""
83	
84	    if not isinstance(value, str):
85	        raise ProvenanceValidationError(f"{label} must be a string.")
86	    if not value:
87	        raise ProvenanceValidationError(f"{label} must not be empty.")
88	    if len(value) > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH:
89	        raise ProvenanceValidationError(
90	            f"{label} must not exceed {MAX_TEXT_LENGTH} Unicode code points."
91	        )
92	    return value
93	
94	
95	def _require_digest(value: object, label: str) -> str:
96	    if not isinstance(value, str) or _DIGEST_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
97	        raise ProvenanceValidationError(
98	            f"{label} must be a 64-character hexadecimal string."
99	        )
100	    return value.lower()
101	
102	
103	def build_provenance_fields(
104	    payload: object,
105	) -> tuple[str, str, str, tuple[Material, ...]]:
106	    """Validate a decoded provenance payload and return normalized values.
107	
108	    Returns ``(builder, build_number, source_digest, materials)``. The
109	    source and material digests are normalized to lowercase and materials
110	    are returned in their submitted order (an empty material list is
111	    allowed). Repeated materials (same name and normalized digest) are a
112	    validation error.
113	    """
114	
115	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
116	        raise ProvenanceValidationError("Request body must be a JSON object.")
117	
118	    unknown_fields = set(payload) - _ALLOWED_FIELDS
119	    if unknown_fields:
120	        raise ProvenanceValidationError(
121	            f"Unknown field: {sorted(unknown_fields)[0]!r}."
122	        )
123	
124	    for field in _REQUIRED_FIELDS:
125	        if field not in payload:
126	            raise ProvenanceValidationError(
127	                f"Missing required field: {field!r}."
128	            )
129	
130	    builder = _required_text(payload["builder"], "Field 'builder'")
131	    build_number = _required_text(
132	        payload["build_number"], "Field 'build_number'"
133	    )
134	    source_digest = _require_digest(
135	        payload["source_digest"], "Field 'source_digest'"
136	    )
137	
138	    raw_materials = payload["materials"]
139	    if not isinstance(raw_materials, list):
140	        raise ProvenanceValidationError("Field 'materials' must be an array.")
141	
142	    materials: list[Material] = []
143	    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
144	    for position, raw_material in enumerate(raw_materials):
145	        if not isinstance(raw_material, dict):
146	            raise ProvenanceValidationError(
147	                f"Material at index {position} must be a JSON object."
148	            )
149	        material_unknown = set(raw_material) - _MATERIAL_FIELDS
150	        if material_unknown:
151	            raise ProvenanceValidationError(
152	                f"Unknown field: {sorted(material_unknown)[0]!r}."
153	            )
154	        for field in ("name", "digest"):
155	            if field not in raw_material:
156	                raise ProvenanceValidationError(
157	                    f"Material at index {position} is missing required "
158	                    f"field: {field!r}."
159	                )
160	        name = _required_text(
161	            raw_material["name"], "Material field 'name'"
162	        )
163	        digest = _require_digest(
164	            raw_material["digest"], "Material field 'digest'"
165	        )
166	        key = (name, digest)
167	        if key in seen:
168	            raise ProvenanceValidationError(
169	                "A material with the same name and digest is listed more "
170	                "than once."
171	            )
172	        seen.add(key)
173	        materials.append(Material(name=name, digest=digest))
174	
175	    return builder, build_number, source_digest, tuple(materials)
176	
177	
178	class ProvenanceStore:
179	    """Process-local storage of at most one provenance record per resource."""
180	
181	    def __init__(self) -> None:
182	        self._records: dict[str, ProvenanceRecord] = {}
183	
184	    def reset(self) -> None:
185	        self._records = {}
186	
187	    def add(
188	        self, resource_id: str, payload: object
189	    ) -> tuple[ProvenanceRecord, bool]:
190	        """Validate and record the provenance for ``resource_id``.
191	
192	        Returns ``(record, created)`` where ``created`` is ``True`` for a
193	        first registration (HTTP 201) and ``False`` for an idempotent repeat
194	        of the exact same normalized content (HTTP 200).
195	
196	        Raises :class:`ProvenanceValidationError` for an invalid payload or
197	        :class:`ProvenanceError` with code ``provenance_conflict`` when a
198	        different record is already stored; the stored record is never
199	        overwritten.
200	        """
201	
202	        builder, build_number, source_digest, materials = (
203	            build_provenance_fields(payload)
204	        )
205	        record = ProvenanceRecord(
206	            builder=builder,
207	            build_number=build_number,
208	            source_digest=source_digest,
209	            materials=materials,
210	        )
211	
212	        existing = self._records.get(resource_id)
213	        if existing is not None:
214	            if existing == record:
215	                return existing, False
216	            raise ProvenanceError(
217	                "provenance_conflict",
218	                "A different provenance record is already registered for "
219	                "this resource.",
220	            )
221	
222	        self._records[resource_id] = record
223	        return record, True
224	
225	    def get(self, resource_id: str) -> ProvenanceRecord | None:
226	        return self._records.get(resource_id)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
from wsgiref.simple_server import make_server

from .app import application, cache_store
from .cache import DEFAULT_CACHE_QUOTA

_POSITIVE_INT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[1-9][0-9]*")


def _cache_quota(value: str) -> int:
    """Argparse type for ``--cache-quota``: a decimal positive integer."""

    if _POSITIVE_INT_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
            "cache quota must be a decimal positive integer"
        )
    return int(value)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Run the digital resource provenance HTTP service."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8000)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache-quota",
        type=_cache_quota,
        default=DEFAULT_CACHE_QUOTA,
        metavar="BYTES",
        help=(
            "layer cache quota in bytes, a decimal positive integer "
            f"(default: {DEFAULT_CACHE_QUOTA})"
        ),
    )
    return parser


def main() -> None:
    args = build_parser().parse_args()
    cache_store.configure(args.cache_quota)
    with make_server(args.host, args.port, application) as server:
        print(f"provenance-api listening on http://{args.host}:{args.port}", flush=True)
        try:
            server.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("provenance-api stopped", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

14	def call(
15	    method: str,
16	    path: str,
17	    body: bytes | str | dict[str, object] | None = None,
18	    *,
19	    query_string: str | None = None,
20	) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]], bytes]:
21	    if body is None:
22	        payload = b""
23	    elif isinstance(body, dict):
24	        payload = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
25	    else:
26	        payload = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body
27	
28	    environ: dict[str, object] = {
29	        "REQUEST_METHOD": method,
30	        "PATH_INFO": path,
31	        "QUERY_STRING": query_string if query_string is not None else "",
32	        "CONTENT_LENGTH": str(len(payload)),
33	        "CONTENT_TYPE": "application/json",
34	        "wsgi.input": io.BytesIO(payload),
35	    }
36	    captured: dict[str, object] = {}
37	
38	    def start_response(status: str, headers: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
39	        captured["status"] = status
40	        captured["headers"] = headers
41	
42	    chunks = application(environ, start_response)
43	    return str(captured["status"]), list(captured["headers"]), b"".join(chunks)
44

46	def call_json(
47	    method: str,
48	    path: str,
49	    body: bytes | str | dict[str, object] | None = None,
50	    *,
51	    query_string: str | None = None,
52	) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]], dict[str, object]]:
53	    status, headers, raw = call(method, path, body, query_string=query_string)
54	    return status, headers, json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))

57	def provenance_payload(
58	    *,
59	    builder: object = "ci-bot",
60	    build_number: object = "build-001",
61	    source_digest: object = DIGEST_A,
62	    materials: object = ...,  # type: ignore[assignment]
63	) -> dict[str, object]:
64	    if materials is ...:
65	        materials = []
66	    return {
67	        "builder": builder,
68	        "build_number": build_number,
69	        "source_digest": source_digest,
70	        "materials": materials,
71	    }

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import unittest

from provenance_api.app import application, reset_state

DIGEST_A = "a" * 64
DIGEST_B = "b" * 64
DIGEST_C = "C" * 64


def call(
    method: str,
    path: str,
    body: bytes | str | dict[str, object] | None = None,
    *,
    query_string: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]], bytes]:
    if body is None:
        payload = b""
    elif isinstance(body, dict):
        payload = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
    else:
        payload = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body

    environ: dict[str, object] = {
        "REQUEST_METHOD": method,
        "PATH_INFO": path,
        "QUERY_STRING": query_string if query_string is not None else "",
        "CONTENT_LENGTH": str(len(payload)),
        "CONTENT_TYPE": "application/json",
        "wsgi.input": io.BytesIO(payload),
    }
    captured: dict[str, object] = {}

    def start_response(status: str, headers: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
        captured["status"] = status
        captured["headers"] = headers

    chunks = application(environ, start_response)
    return str(captured["status"]), list(captured["headers"]), b"".join(chunks)


def call_json(
    method: str,
    path: str,
    body: bytes | str | dict[str, object] | None = None,
    *,
    query_string: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]], dict[str, object]]:
    status, headers, raw = call(method, path, body, query_string=query_string)
    return status, headers, json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))


def provenance_payload(
    *,
    builder: object = "ci-bot",
    build_number: object = "build-001",
    source_digest: object = DIGEST_A,
    materials: object = ...,  # type: ignore[assignment]
) -> dict[str, object]:
    if materials is ...:
        materials = []
    return {
        "builder": builder,
        "build_number": build_number,
        "source_digest": source_digest,
        "materials": materials,
    }


class ProvenanceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        reset_state()
        self.resource_id = self._create(DIGEST_A)
        self.other_id = self._create(DIGEST_B, name="other")

    def _create(self, digest: str, name: str = "r") -> str:
        _s, _h, body = call_json(
            "POST",
            "/resources",
            {"name": name, "category": "code", "digest": digest},
        )
        return str(body["id"])

    def _register(
        self,
        resource_id: str | None = None,
        *,
        payload: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    ):
        target = self.resource_id if resource_id is None else resource_id
        return call_json(
            "POST",
            f"/resources/{target}/provenance",
            payload if payload is not None else provenance_payload(),
        )

    # --- Registration ------------------------------------------------------

    def test_register_returns_201_and_echoes_fields(self) -> None:
        payload = provenance_payload(
            builder="builder-1",
            build_number="42",
            source_digest=DIGEST_C,
            materials=[
                {"name": "openssl", "digest": DIGEST_B},
                {"name": "zlib", "digest": DIGEST_A},
            ],
        )
        status, headers, body = self._register(payload=payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, "201 Created")
        self.assertEqual(
            headers[0], ("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            set(body),
            {"id", "builder", "build_number", "source_digest", "materials"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.resource_id)
        self.assertEqual(body["builder"], "builder-1")
        self.assertEqual(body["build_number"], "42")
        self.assertEqual(body["source_digest"], "c" * 64)
        self.assertEqual(
            body["materials"],
            [
                {"name": "openssl", "digest": DIGEST_B},
                {"name": "zlib", "digest": DIGEST_A},
            ],
        )

    def test_digests_normalized_to_lowercase(self) -> None:
        payload = provenance_payload(
            source_digest="AbC" + "0" * 61,
            materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": "DeF" + "0" * 61}],
        )
        _s, _h, body = self._register(payload=payload)
        self.assertEqual(body["source_digest"], "abc" + "0" * 61)
        self.assertEqual(body["materials"][0]["digest"], "def" + "0" * 61)

    def test_empty_materials_is_valid(self) -> None:
        status, _h, body = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(materials=[]))
        self.assertEqual(status, "201 Created")
        self.assertEqual(body["materials"], [])

    def test_materials_keep_submission_order(self) -> None:
        payload = provenance_payload(
            materials=[
                {"name": "third", "digest": DIGEST_C},
                {"name": "first", "digest": DIGEST_A},
                {"name": "second", "digest": DIGEST_B},
            ]
        )
        _s, _h, body = self._register(payload=payload)
        self.assertEqual(
            [m["name"] for m in body["materials"]],
            ["third", "first", "second"],
        )

    def test_response_is_compact_utf8_newline_terminated(self) -> None:
        status, _headers, raw = call(
            "POST",
            f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance",
            provenance_payload(
                builder="构建机",
                materials=[{"name": "库", "digest": DIGEST_A}],
            ),
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, "201 Created")
        self.assertTrue(raw.endswith(b"\n"))
        self.assertNotIn(b" ", raw[:-1])
        text = raw.decode("utf-8").rstrip("\n")
        keys = ['"id"', '"builder"', '"build_number"',
                '"source_digest"', '"materials"']
        positions = [text.index(k) for k in keys]
        self.assertEqual(positions, sorted(positions))

    # --- Query -------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_get_returns_registered_provenance(self) -> None:
        post = self._register()[2]
        status, _h, body = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, "200 OK")
        self.assertEqual(body, post)

    def test_get_without_registration_is_404(self) -> None:
        status, _h, body = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, "404 Not Found")
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "provenance_not_found")

    # --- Idempotency and conflicts ----------------------------------------

    def test_same_content_resubmitted_is_idempotent_200(self) -> None:
        first = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(
            builder="b", build_number="1", source_digest=DIGEST_A,
            materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B}],
        ))
        self.assertEqual(first[0], "201 Created")
        second = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(
            builder="b", build_number="1", source_digest=DIGEST_A,
            materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B}],
        ))
        self.assertEqual(second[0], "200 OK")
        self.assertEqual(second[2], first[2])

        # Mixed-case digests normalizing to the same record are the same.
        status, _h, _body = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(
            builder="b", build_number="1", source_digest="A" * 64,
            materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": "B" * 64}],
        ))
        self.assertEqual(status, "200 OK")

    def test_different_provenance_conflicts(self) -> None:
        base = provenance_payload(
            builder="b", build_number="1", source_digest=DIGEST_A,
            materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B}],
        )
        original = self._register(payload=base)[2]
        variants = [
            provenance_payload(builder="other", build_number="1",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_A,
                               materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B}]),
            provenance_payload(builder="b", build_number="2",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_A,
                               materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B}]),
            provenance_payload(builder="b", build_number="1",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_C,
                               materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B}]),
            provenance_payload(builder="b", build_number="1",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_A, materials=[]),
            provenance_payload(builder="b", build_number="1",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_A,
                               materials=[{"name": "other",
                                           "digest": DIGEST_B}]),
            # Same materials in a different order is different content.
            provenance_payload(builder="b", build_number="1",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_A,
                               materials=[
                                   {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B},
                                   {"name": "n", "digest": DIGEST_C},
                               ]),
            provenance_payload(builder="b", build_number="1",
                               source_digest=DIGEST_A,
                               materials=[
                                   {"name": "n", "digest": DIGEST_C},
                                   {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B},
                               ]),
        ]
        for payload in variants:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                status, _h, body = self._register(payload=payload)
                self.assertEqual(status, "409 Conflict")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "provenance_conflict")

        # The original record is untouched.
        _s, _h, body = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(body, original)

    def test_one_record_per_resource_is_scoped(self) -> None:
        self._register(self.resource_id)
        self._register(
            self.other_id, payload=provenance_payload(builder="other-bot")
        )
        _s, _h, first = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        _s, _h, second = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.other_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(first["builder"], "ci-bot")
        self.assertEqual(second["builder"], "other-bot")

    # --- Materials ---------------------------------------------------------

    def test_duplicate_material_is_400_and_stores_nothing(self) -> None:
        material = {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_A}
        status, _h, body = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(
            materials=[material, dict(material)]
        ))
        self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")
        _s, _h, get = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(get["error"], "provenance_not_found")

    def test_duplicate_material_matches_case_insensitively(self) -> None:
        status, _h, body = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(
            materials=[
                {"name": "m", "digest": "A" * 64},
                {"name": "m", "digest": "a" * 64},
            ]
        ))
        self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_same_name_different_digest_is_distinct(self) -> None:
        status, _h, _body = self._register(payload=provenance_payload(
            materials=[
                {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_A},
                {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_B},
            ]
        ))
        self.assertEqual(status, "201 Created")

    # --- Bad request: body -------------------------------------------------

    def test_missing_body_is_bad_request(self) -> None:
        status, _h, body = call_json(
            "POST", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance", None
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_malformed_or_bad_utf8_body_is_bad_request(self) -> None:
        path = f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        for raw in (b"{bad", b"\xff\xfe"):
            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
                status, _h, body = call_json("POST", path, raw)
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_non_object_body_is_bad_request(self) -> None:
        for raw in (b"[]", b'"x"', b"42", b"null"):
            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
                status, _h, body = call_json(
                    "POST", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance", raw
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    # --- Bad request: fields -----------------------------------------------

    def test_missing_required_fields(self) -> None:
        fields = ("builder", "build_number", "source_digest", "materials")
        for field in fields:
            payload = provenance_payload()
            del payload[field]
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                status, _h, body = self._register(payload=payload)
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_empty_object_is_bad_request(self) -> None:
        status, _h, body = self._register(payload={})
        self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_unknown_field_rejected(self) -> None:
        payload = provenance_payload()
        payload["extra"] = 1
        status, _h, body = self._register(payload=payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_text_field_errors(self) -> None:
        for field in ("builder", "build_number"):
            for value in (1, None, True, "", [], {}):
                with self.subTest(field=field, value=value):
                    status, _h, body = self._register(
                        payload=provenance_payload(**{field: value})
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                    self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_text_fields_limit_256_code_points(self) -> None:
        fresh = 0

        def fresh_id() -> str:
            nonlocal fresh
            fresh += 1
            return self._create(
                f"{fresh:064x}", name=f"r{fresh}"
            )

        for field in ("builder", "build_number"):
            payload = provenance_payload(**{field: "あ" * 257})
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                status, _h, body = self._register(
                    resource_id=fresh_id(), payload=payload
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")
            payload = provenance_payload(**{field: "あ" * 256})
            with self.subTest(field=field, ok=True):
                status, _h, _body = self._register(
                    resource_id=fresh_id(), payload=payload
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "201 Created")

    def test_source_digest_errors(self) -> None:
        for value in (
            "a" * 63, "g" * 64, "A" * 65, "", 1, None, True,
        ):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                status, _h, body = self._register(
                    payload=provenance_payload(source_digest=value)
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_materials_must_be_array(self) -> None:
        for value in ({}, "x", 1, None, True):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                status, _h, body = self._register(
                    payload=provenance_payload(materials=value)
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_material_must_be_object(self) -> None:
        for bad in ([[]], ["x"], [1], [None], [[]]):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                status, _h, body = self._register(
                    payload=provenance_payload(materials=bad)
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_material_field_errors(self) -> None:
        cases = [
            {},
            {"digest": DIGEST_A},
            {"name": "m"},
            {"name": "", "digest": DIGEST_A},
            {"name": 1, "digest": DIGEST_A},
            {"name": None, "digest": DIGEST_A},
            {"name": True, "digest": DIGEST_A},
            {"name": "m", "digest": ""},
            {"name": "m", "digest": 1},
            {"name": "m", "digest": None},
            {"name": "m", "digest": "a" * 63},
            {"name": "m", "digest": "g" * 64},
            {"name": "m", "digest": "A" * 65},
            {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_A, "extra": 1},
            {"name": "x" * 257, "digest": DIGEST_A},
        ]
        for material in cases:
            with self.subTest(material=material):
                status, _h, body = self._register(
                    payload=provenance_payload(materials=[material])
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_material_name_limit_256_code_points(self) -> None:
        status, _h, _body = self._register(
            payload=provenance_payload(
                materials=[{"name": "😀" * 256, "digest": DIGEST_A}]
            )
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, "201 Created")

    # --- Path, query, method, missing resource -----------------------------

    def test_empty_path_id_is_bad_request(self) -> None:
        for method, body in [
            ("GET", None),
            ("POST", provenance_payload()),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(method=method):
                status, _h, payload = call_json(
                    method, "/resources//provenance", body
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(payload["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_path_id_with_separator_is_bad_request(self) -> None:
        for raw in ("a/b", "a\\b"):
            for method in ("GET", "POST"):
                with self.subTest(raw=raw, method=method):
                    status, _h, body = call_json(
                        method, f"/resources/{raw}/provenance"
                    )
                    self.assertIn(status[:3], {"400", "404"})
                    self.assertEqual(body["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_query_parameters_rejected(self) -> None:
        for method, body in [
            ("GET", None),
            ("POST", provenance_payload()),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(method=method):
                status, _h, payload = call_json(
                    method,
                    f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance",
                    body,
                    query_string="x=1",
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "400 Bad Request")
                self.assertEqual(payload["error"], "invalid_request")

    def test_missing_resource_is_404(self) -> None:
        for method, body in [
            ("GET", None),
            ("POST", provenance_payload()),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(method=method):
                status, _h, payload = call_json(
                    method, "/resources/missing/provenance", body
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "404 Not Found")
                self.assertEqual(payload["error"], "resource_not_found")

    def test_unsupported_methods_return_405_with_allow(self) -> None:
        for method in ("PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH"):
            with self.subTest(method=method):
                status, headers, body = call_json(
                    method, f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, "405 Method Not Allowed")
                self.assertEqual(body["error"], "method_not_allowed")
                self.assertIn(("Allow", "GET, POST"), headers)

    def test_failed_requests_leave_no_record(self) -> None:
        call_json(
            "POST", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance", b"not json"
        )
        self._register(payload=provenance_payload(builder=""))
        self._register(payload=provenance_payload(source_digest="x"))
        self._register(
            payload=provenance_payload(
                materials=[{"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_A},
                           {"name": "m", "digest": DIGEST_A}]
            )
        )
        call_json("GET", "/resources/missing/provenance")
        _s, _h, body = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(body["error"], "provenance_not_found")

    def test_failed_conflict_does_not_change_other_state(self) -> None:
        self._register(payload=provenance_payload(builder="first"))
        self._register(payload=provenance_payload(builder="second"))
        # Resource itself and unrelated endpoints remain intact.
        status, _h, body = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, "200 OK")
        self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.resource_id)
        _s, _h, prov = call_json(
            "GET", f"/resources/{self.resource_id}/provenance"
        )
        self.assertEqual(prov["builder"], "first")


if __name__ == "__main__":
